_about: Classical ANOVA and post-hoc rules (R/stat_tests.R, table stat_tests.tsv). The design picks the test; assumption checks are reported, not used to switch tests (pre-testing distorts error rates). Biodes may override with analysis.posthoc = {type: pairwise | vs_control | none, control: level, adjust: method}.
_note_sphericity_correction: GG (Greenhouse-Geisser) for every within-subject term with more than two levels; 'girden': Huynh-Feldt when the GG epsilon > girden_threshold (Girden 1992), else GG; 'none'.
_note_adjust: p-value adjustment within each family of comparisons (one family per 'by' level, emmeans default). Holm: valid under any dependence and never less powerful than Bonferroni. vs_control uses dunnettx unless analysis.posthoc.adjust says otherwise.
_note_emmeans_model: within-subject contrasts from the multivariate model: each contrast has its own variance (a paired t-test when there are no between factors), so no sphericity assumption.

families.treatment_effect: main-effect pairs of each treatment factor (averaged over the others); simple effects of the first factor within each level of the second when two treatment factors interact
families.interaction: simple effects: pairs of each goal factor within each level of the other
families.time_course: pairs of time points within each group (within the named group for scope within_group)
families.trend: none: the slope is the test

_note_outlier_iqr: extreme outliers: beyond Q1 - 3 IQR or Q3 + 3 IQR within a cell (rstatix::identify_outliers is.extreme).
